newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 140-day BBCs at 2.198 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 140-day BBCs at 2.198 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 1.394 billion reais of 140-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight rate of 2.198 percent a month, dealers said.
It was the first time the Central Bank offered 140-day BBCs, replacing 133-day BBCs, which were put on sale in the last two weeks.
The Central Bank also sold 1.363 billion reais in 182-day BBCs at an overnight rate of 2.224 percent a month, down from 2.281 percent last week.
The financial result of the auction indicated 2.243 billion reais will be added to the banking system as 5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
